sessions_status_moments.name: sessions_status_moments
sessions_status_moments.value:
CASE "sessions"."status"
        WHEN 'in_progress' THEN "sessions"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "sessions"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "sessions"."ended_at" IS NULL
        WHEN 'completed' THEN "sessions"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "sessions"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "sessions"."ended_at" IS NULL
        WHEN 'incomplete' THEN "sessions"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "sessions"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "sessions"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL
        WHEN 'skipped' THEN "sessions"."started_at" IS NULL AND "sessions"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "sessions"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL
      END

sessions_end_reason_matches_status.name: sessions_end_reason_matches_status
sessions_end_reason_matches_status.value:
("sessions"."end_reason" IS NOT NULL) = ("sessions"."status" IN ('incomplete', 'skipped'))
        AND ("sessions"."status" <> 'skipped' OR "sessions"."end_reason" IN ('pain', 'illness', 'no_time', 'other'))

sessions_end_note_needs_reason.name: sessions_end_note_needs_reason
sessions_end_note_needs_reason.value: "sessions"."end_note" IS NULL OR "sessions"."end_reason" IS NOT NULL

sessions_check_out_when_ended.name: sessions_check_out_when_ended
sessions_check_out_when_ended.value:
("sessions"."pain_after" IS NULL AND "sessions"."mobility_after" IS NULL)
        OR "sessions"."status" IN ('completed', 'incomplete')

sessions_skip_records_no_work.name: sessions_skip_records_no_work
sessions_skip_records_no_work.value:
"sessions"."status" <> 'skipped' OR (
        "sessions"."total_duration_in_seconds" IS NULL
        AND "sessions"."session_feedback" IS NULL
        AND ("sessions"."pain_before" IS NULL OR "sessions"."end_reason" = 'pain')
      )

program_alert_reviews_some_fact.name: program_alert_reviews_some_fact
program_alert_reviews_some_fact.value: "program_alert_reviews"."missed_since" IS NOT NULL OR "program_alert_reviews"."inactive_since" IS NOT NULL
